business_summary: FSE Lifestyle Services Limited, an investment holding company, provides city essential services in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and Macau. It operates through Property & Facility Management Services; City Essential Services; and Electrical and Mechanical Engineering (E&M) Services segments. The company offers property management, sales, and leasing; facility management; property agency services; car park management; and asset management advisory services. It also provides cleaning, disinfection, and pest control services; waste disposal, recycling, and environmental disposal services; security services; insurance solutions; technical support and maintenance; guarding and event services; and environmental solutions, including environmental and extra low voltage engineering, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, and landscaping services, as well as EV charging infrastructure services and trading of EV charging and building materials. In addition, the company is involved in providing engineering and consultancy services on installation; trading securities investments, ceramic tiles, building materials and equipment; provision of maintenance and fitting out services, mechanical and electrical engineering, chemical and plumbing engineering, project management consultancy, testing and calibration, referral, insurance and reinsurance brokerage, fleet management, and property repair and maintenance services; and sale and maintenance of alarm systems. The company was formerly known as FSE Services Group Limited and changed its name to FSE Lifestyle Services Limited in April 2021. FSE Services Group Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong. FSE Services Group Limited is a subsidiary of FSE Holdings Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 FSE Lifestyle Services Limited는 홍콩, 중국 본토 및 마카오에서 도시 필수 서비스를 제공합니다. 자산 및 시설 관리 서비스를 통해 운영됩니다. 도시 필수 서비스; 전기 및 기계 공학(E&M) 서비스 부문. 이 회사는 자산 관리, 판매 및 임대를 제공합니다. 시설관리; 부동산 중개 서비스; 주차장 관리; 및 자산관리 자문 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 청소, 소독, 해충 방제 서비스도 제공합니다. 폐기물 처리, 재활용 및 환경 처리 서비스; 보안 서비스; 보험 솔루션; 기술 지원 및 유지 관리; 경비 및 이벤트 서비스; 환경 및 초저압 엔지니어링, 전기 자동차(EV) 인프라, 조경 서비스, EV 충전 인프라 서비스, EV 충전 및 건축 자재 거래 등을 포함한 환경 솔루션을 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 설치에 대한 엔지니어링 및 컨설팅 서비스 제공에도 참여하고 있습니다. 증권 투자, 세라믹 타일, 건축 자재 및 장비 거래; 유지보수 및 설비 서비스 제공(기계 및 선택)
